summary: Authenticator maps support {% for_attr_value(<attribute>) %} to loop over IdP attribute values, for example Org {% for_attr_value(users_orgs) %} yields Org Database and Org Networking; using it twice produces every combination.
questions: How do I create organizations dynamically from an IdP attribute?
What is for_attr_value in authenticator maps?
Can I map users to many organizations from one map?
